text:
Type: console table with glass top
Use: display, storage, holding keys and decor; living room, hallway, entryway, behind a sofa
Style: classic, traditional, Scandinavian
Materials: painted wood in a white finish, clear glass top panel
Colors: white, clear glass
Shape: long narrow top, two open display compartments under glass, full-length lower shelf, slender tapered legs, light and open
Feel: bright, elegant, airy, tidy
Goes with: white or pale walls, silver or glass accents, light grey textiles; classic or traditional living rooms and entryways

product.name: LIATORP
product.description: Can be placed behind a sofa, along a wall, or be used as a room divider.
